simple.meaning: סָאַן (çâʼan) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to shoe , i.e. (active participle) a soldier shod.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Isaiah, beginning at Isaiah 9:4. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סָאַן (H5431) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: סָאַן (çâʼan) / H5431 is traced through Isaiah 9:4 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.short: to shoe , i.e. (active participle) a soldier shod
definitions.full: H5431. saan [ סָאַן ] verb probably denominative tread, tramp ; — only Qal Participle בְּרַעַשׁ סֹאֵן Isa 9:4 (see foregoing).
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root; to be miry; used only as denominative from 5430 ;

occurrences.englishText: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as in the day of Midian.
